name: Anaconda MCP
summary: Anaconda's hosted, read-only MCP server that gives coding agents conda package facts, curated CVE data with fixed versions, org channel policy and forum search.
description: GA on 2026-10-02 at https://anaconda.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP); the beta ran locally, so Anaconda recommends uninstalling the old anaconda-mcp package. Four tools: package_info and search_forum work with any Anaconda account; package_security (severity, CVSS, CWE, analyst notes and a fixed-version MatchSpec) and org_config (Package Security Manager channel policies) need a Business or Enterprise subscription. The server only returns data; it can't install or change anything. Ships with a free Anaconda Intelligence skill that tells the agent which tool to call when. Connect via the Anaconda CLI, the Kilo Marketplace or any remote-MCP client.

agent_access.notes: Sign in with an anaconda.com account (OAuth protected-resource metadata advertised on 401). Policy fields are null without Business/Enterprise.
